code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    # Separator is the color forming complete rows and columns.
    separator = next(v for v in colors
                     if any(all(row[c] == v for row in grid) for c in range(w))
                     and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for c in range(w)) for r in range(h)))
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == separator for x in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    marker = min((v for v in colors if v != separator), key=lambda v: colors[v])
    return [[1 if any(grid[r][c] == marker
                      for r in range(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                      for c in range(col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])) else 2
             for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
            for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    separator = next(v for v in colors
                     if any(all(row[c] == v for row in grid) for c in range(w))
                     and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for c in range(w)) for r in range(h)))
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == separator for x in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    content_colors = [v for v in colors if v != separator]
    marker = min(content_colors, key=lambda v: colors[v])
    background = max(content_colors, key=lambda v: colors[v])
    result = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                        for r in range(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                        for c in range(col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1]))
            out_row.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
'''
